column3: Close to the Hebrew; “his right hand has saved for him” is rendered “have gained Him the victory.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְקוֹל זִמְרָה (“the sound of melody”) is rendered “the sound of a psalm.”
Close to the Hebrew; שׁוֹפָר (“the ram’s horn”) is rendered “a horn.”
Close to the Hebrew; “mountains” is rendered “the hills,” and NKJV moves “before the LORD” from v9.
